summary: Inspected app and shared-ui components to audit duplication and then searched for dead or dynamically-set data-ui selectors across CSS and Svelte sources. The session also ran a Python script to cross-check CSS data-ui names against markup usage and invoked the Svelte autofixer on App.svelte, which produced suggestions but no required fixes.
decisions: apps/app/src/lib/components/index.ts re-exports workbench primitives (Button, Dialog, DiffView, Toast, Tooltip, toasts, ToastQueue) from @gizmo/ui so existing app imports keep working
ConfirmDialog.svelte puts the Cancel button before the confirm action and makes Cancel the default focus target to avoid a single-button destructive modal
errors: One grep command exited with code 1 due to a PowerShell parser error: 'Missing ')' in method call' — cause not identified in the transcript
